_comment: Hand inventory of the third-party code, fonts and images COPIED into the public copy of the WCS (not restored from NuGet). Source of the embedded part of sbom/wcs.cdx.json (New-WcsSbom.ps1) and kept in step with overlay/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Built on 2026-10-15 from the files at feature/open-source-fase-a by reading the banners, headers and version strings of the bundles. 'uncertain' says what could not be established from the files themselves.

components.name: draw.io
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2006-2025, JGraph Holdings Ltd; Copyright (c) 2006-2025, draw.io AG
components.uncertain: js/bootstrap.js was modified by Sun Tech (registers plugins/kazam.js) and carries no Apache-2.0 4(b) change notice of its own; whether other files were changed when the bundle was copied (internal commit 79b88ca9) was not verified file by file against the upstream release.

components.name: mxGraph (as shipped in draw.io)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2006-2017, JGraph Holdings Ltd; Copyright (c) 2006-2017, draw.io AG

components.name: pako
components.location: WCS/Wcs.WebEditor/src/wwwroot/drawio/js/app.min.js (and an older copy inside JSZip, js/extensions.min.js)
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn; zlib parts (C) 1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler
components.uncertain: The licence texts come from pako 1.0.11 (found locally) and from the zlib licence; the copyright lines of 2.2.0 were not checked against its own LICENSE. The version of the pako copy inside JSZip is not stated.

components.name: CryptoJS
components.copyright: (c) 2009-2013 by Jeff Mott. All rights reserved.
components.uncertain: The bundle points to code.google.com/p/crypto-js/wiki/License (offline). The text in licenses/ is the standard BSD-3-Clause wording with Jeff Mott's notice, reconstructed, not copied from the component.

components.name: spin.js
components.uncertain: The bundle states only the URL and version; licence and copyright line come from the project, not from the file.

components.name: Rough.js
components.uncertain: Not listed in the previous NOTICE. The bundle carries no banner, version or licence for it: identified by its code. Licence text taken from roughjs 4.6.6 found locally.

components.name: JSZip
components.copyright: (c) 2009-2016 Stuart Knightley, David Duponchel, Franz Buchinger, António Afonso
components.uncertain: LICENSE.markdown taken from JSZip 3.10.1 found locally.

components.name: @drawio/elk (Eclipse Layout Kernel)
components.copyright: Kiel University and others (Eclipse Layout Kernel contributors)
components.uncertain: The bundle states no licence for @drawio/elk. It contains the ELK layout algorithms (org.eclipse.elk.*), which Eclipse distributes under EPL-2.0. Licence text taken from elkjs 0.11.1 found locally. Which ELK release it was built from is not stated.

components.name: @drawio/mermaid
components.uncertain: A draw.io package: the bundle states no licence. It contains graphlib, dagre, parts of lodash, layout-base and cose-base (listed separately). Whether it contains code of Mermaid (MIT, Knut Sveidqvist) was not established.

components.name: dagre / @dagrejs/graphlib
components.version: dagre 3.0.0, graphlib 4.0.1 (a second graphlib 2.1.9-pre is also present)
components.uncertain: The bundle says 'For license information please see dagre.min.js.LEGAL.txt' and that file is not shipped. Versions read from version strings in the code.

components.name: lodash (parts)
components.copyright: Copyright OpenJS Foundation and other contributors
components.uncertain: Version not stated; licence text from lodash 4.18.1 found locally.

components.name: layout-base and cose-base
components.uncertain: Not listed in the previous NOTICE; identified by their UMD module names. Versions not stated; licence texts from layout-base 1.0.2 and cose-base 1.0.3 found locally.

components.name: Bridge.NET
components.uncertain: The banner says 'See license.txt': that file is not shipped. Apache-2.0 per the linked LICENSE.md.

components.name: OrgChart.Layout (compiled with Bridge.NET)
components.uncertain: Neither author nor licence is stated in the bundle. It ships with draw.io (js/orgchart in the draw.io sources); its origin and licence have to be checked there.

components.name: libavoid (Adaptagrams), via libavoid-js
components.location: WCS/Wcs.WebEditor/src/wwwroot/drawio/js/extensions.min.js (initAvoidModule: libavoid compiled to JavaScript with Emscripten)
components.copyright: libavoid: Monash University and the Adaptagrams contributors
components.uncertain: Not listed in the previous NOTICE, and the bundle states no licence or copyright for it: identified by its code and by draw.io's comment naming 'libavoid-js 0.5.0-beta.5'. LGPL text taken from Git for Windows (xz, COPYING.LGPLv2.1). The Emscripten runtime around it is MIT OR NCSA (text not included).

components.name: WebCola
components.uncertain: cola.min.js carries no banner, version or licence. The draw.io adaptor files next to it are draw.io's (JGraph).

components.name: Architects Daughter (font)
components.uncertain: The font file states its copyright but no licence; OFL-1.1 is the licence under which Google Fonts distributes it. OFL text taken from a local copy (Source Sans Pro, in a VS Code extension) without its Adobe header.

components.name: draw.io icon sets and stencil libraries
components.copyright: JGraph Holdings Ltd / draw.io AG; vendor icons are trademarks of their owners
components.uncertain: Apache-2.0 as part of draw.io, plus the restriction of img/LICENSE (no use in or for Atlassian products without written permission). Many sets reproduce logos and product icons of third parties (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, IBM, SAP, Atlassian, Dropbox, Google Drive ...).

components.name: net-object-deep-copy
components.uncertain: Derived and modified (namespaces, nullable annotations, layout); the export adds the attribution header to the four files.
